Package io.telekom.orchest.scheduling.config

Class TaskSchedulerAutoConfiguration

java.lang.Object
io.telekom.orchest.scheduling.config.TaskSchedulerAutoConfiguration
@AutoConfiguration @ConditionalOnProperty(prefix="orchest.scheduler", name="enabled", havingValue="true", matchIfMissing=true) @EnableConfigurationProperties(SchedulerProperties.class) public class TaskSchedulerAutoConfiguration extends Object
Spring Boot auto-configuration for the task scheduler.

Wires up the producer-side TaskScheduler whenever a ScheduledTaskStore bean is present (the host application provides one — the Mongo default lives in mongo-data-adapter). The TaskDispatcher is only started when orchest.scheduler.dispatcher-enabled=true.
